title: Batch Record Inspection Checklist Form
subtitle: Route the batch execution and production record control, verify readiness, record requirement-level results, contain exceptions, authorize status, and preserve accountable closeout.
description: An operational batch record inspection checklist form for controlling a manufacturing batch and its complete execution history from assignment through evidence-based inspection, exception containment, disposition, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when a batch production recorder must inspect a manufacturing batch and its complete execution history against the approved master instruction, formula or bill, routing, and batch procedure and provide a traceable basis to reconcile, review, hold, or release the completed batch record.

sections.title: Batch Record inspection assignment
sections.guidance: Identify the exact item, reference set, inspection owner, and routing deadline.

blocks.label: Manufacturing Batch And Its Complete Execution History identity
Inspection scope, reason, boundaries, and required outcome

sections.title: Acceptance basis and inspection readiness
sections.guidance: Confirm the current approved master instruction, formula or bill, routing, and batch procedure and the evidence needed to inspect.

blocks.label: Pre-inspection readiness checkpoints
items: Issued record matches the current approved master instruction and batch identity
Materials record item, supplier or internal lot, required amount, actual amount, and verifier
Equipment and line IDs are recorded with cleaning or readiness status
Each significant step records date, time, result, performer, and verifier where required
Process parameters, calculations, units, conversions, and actual values are legible
Samples and in-process tests link to the correct batch, step, time, and result
Yield, scrap, rework, rejects, and material usage are reconciled at defined stages
Deviations, alarms, interruptions, and atypical results retain original evidence

blocks.label: Available evidence package
items: Approved master instruction or formula and issued batch record revision
Material item, lot, required quantity, actual quantity, and verification
Equipment identity, cleaning, maintenance, and line-clearance status
Significant-step time, parameter, result, performer, and verifier entries
In-process sample, test, calculation, and yield result
Deviation, alarm, interruption, rework, or atypical-result record
Packaging, label, component, scrap, and finished-quantity reconciliation
Production review, quality review, final disposition, and archive reference

sections.title: Batch Record inspection execution
sections.guidance: Record actual observations and results against identifiable requirements.

blocks.label: Batch step execution and parameter evidence
blocks.guidance: Record actual values where the requirement is variable; do not use pass-only entries when evidence is available.

blocks.label: Execution and traceability controls
items: Process parameters, calculations, units, conversions, and actual values are legible
Samples and in-process tests link to the correct batch, step, time, and result
Yield, scrap, rework, rejects, and material usage are reconciled at defined stages
Deviations, alarms, interruptions, and atypical results retain original evidence
Packaging and labeling quantities reconcile to issued, used, returned, and destroyed amounts
Corrections preserve the original entry, reason, author, and date under site procedure
Open deviations, investigations, and out-of-specification results are visible at review
Final production and quality review documents disposition and remaining restrictions

blocks.label: Inspection observations, evidence references, sample rationale, and limitations

sections.title: Findings, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every exception visible with immediate control, ownership, and a disposition route.

blocks.label: Batch Record exceptions requiring action
items: Issued record or master instruction revision is incorrect
Material lot, amount, verifier, or equipment identity is missing
Significant step lacks actual time, value, performer, or required verification
Parameter, calculation, yield, or test result is outside the instruction
Deviation, alarm, interruption, or atypical result is not contemporaneously recorded
Correction obscures the original entry or lacks reason and attribution
Material, label, scrap, reject, rework, or finished quantity does not reconcile
Batch disposition occurs with an open deviation, investigation, or review gap
blocks.guidance: Select every applicable exception and preserve the original observation.

blocks.label: Exception, containment, ownership, and disposition log
Exception facts, affected scope, containment boundary, and unresolved risk

sections.title: Inspection decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Document the evidence-based decision to reconcile, review, hold, or release the completed batch record.

blocks.label: Decision boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records inspection evidence and routing. Use qualified personnel and the applicable approved master instruction, formula or bill, routing, and batch procedure for technical acceptance, safety, customer, or regulatory decisions.

blocks.label: Acceptance rationale, conditions, rejected evidence, and scope of authorization

fields.label: Production And Quality Record Reviewer / date

sections.title: Follow-up, handoff, and inspection closeout
sections.guidance: Close only when open work, evidence ownership, limitations, and receiving handoff are explicit.

blocks.label: Open action and accountable handoff register
Final decision basis, residual limitations, next action, and receiving handoff

fields.label: Outcome rationale and accountable handoff summary

blocks.label: Accountable review and closeout

fields.label: Production And Quality Record Reviewer / date

blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not replace required technical or regulatory approval.
